title: Why Agents Love Supabase
author: swyx .ai
description: Paul Copplestone and Ant Wilson on building the backend for AI agents
summary: I first met Paul Copplestone and Ant Wilson in Singapore, shortly after they finished YC as the hottest startup of YC S20 . Six years later, we finally got them on the podcast!
takeaways: Watch the full conversation, including my opening commentary → Give the agent a backend it can read My favorite developer-tool announcements make me think: of course I want this today.
From prototype to petabyte The founders say Supabase is launching about five million databases a month.
The things that stood out to me were surprisingly practical: start a local backend without Docker, keep the desired database schema in Git, and run compute beside the database.
